tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand palette. The main logo ink and headline ink on off-white, white and ice.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Brand palette. The default page ground (RGB 247/246/243).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Brand palette. Secondary text, captions and labels on off-white, white and ice (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Brand palette. The one brand hue: logo on light grounds, primary actions, reversed fields. Follows printed RGB 11/43/74.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Brand palette. A supporting field and the symbol colour on midnight; never fine lettering on white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand palette. Raised panels on off-white; reversed logo and text on midnight.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, logo stages and panels sitting on surface. Flat — no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Ice callouts and supporting fields (notes, app-icon ground). Text on it is ink-on-field.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface and surface-raised (≥19:1 light, ≥12:1 midnight).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions and mono labels on surface and surface-raised (≥7.6:1 light, ≥8:1 midnight).

tokens.name: ink-on-field
tokens.usage: Text on surface-field (ice) in either theme (≥9.8:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and text links' underline colour.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill (14:1 light, 9.8:1 midnight).

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The logo and symbol drawn inline. Black or midnight on light grounds; always white when reversed.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: header/footer dividers and section splits. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary-button border, from the kit. Light theme is 2.1:1 on white and 1.9:1 on off-white — below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept as supplied, pair the border with a clear label.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px outline, 4px offset (≥8:1 on every surface of its theme).

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Inter Display 500, tight tracking. Where Inter Display is not installed, Inter at optical size 32 stands in.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One hero line per page. On the web it may scale fluidly (clamp 2.5rem–5rem).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter Regular 400 for body and UI.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A working set of vector masters, editable templates and implementation files.
styles.usage: Body copy and UI text, in ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Outlined vectors keep the logo independent of installed fonts.
styles.usage: Captions under figures and small print, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Space Mono, uppercase, wide tracking. Never used for the wordmark.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, metadata and technical captions — always set in UPPERCASE.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and swatches.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; grid gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; primary button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header and footer padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, cards, fields, stages. No rounded corners anywhere.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules in line; secondary-button border.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Supporting-icon strokes at 64px (butt caps, miter joins).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline thickness, in focus-ring.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

size.note: Minimum sizes and layout widths (recommendations from the guide).

tokens.name: logo-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest width for the full ddcnorth lockup on screen.

tokens.name: symbol-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest width for the symbol alone (favicons excepted).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.
